question.problem:
What is the surface area of the triangular prism represented by the net below?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14249141/assets/dafb07440f60418465b579aad73119cd47d6def34ed0cf1229afc9affbb177e4.png)
question.worked_solution:
The surface area of our prism consists of $2$ triangles (base and top) and $3$ rectangles (side faces). 

Adding the areas, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Surface area} & =2\times (\text{Area of base})+3\times (\text{Area of side}) \\  & =2\times 12+3\times 48 \\  & =24+144 \\  & =168\,{\text{cm}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
